descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Kids Chaos VR is a funny VR daycare chaos game where a normal playroom turns into total mayhem.

Step into a colorful daycare full of toys, kids, silly pranks, funny hats, food reactions, and one very dramatic grandma trying to keep everything under control.

Play tag with the kids, run through the daycare, use toys, unlock hats, collect coins, and create chaotic moments around the room. Throw a banana peel, spray a water gun, play with a ball, try different foods, and watch the characters react in funny ways.

The game is designed for short, energetic VR sessions with simple gameplay, bright cartoon visuals, and playful comedy.

Features:
- Funny VR tag gameplay
- Colorful daycare playroom environment
- Mischievous kids and a dramatic grandma
- Banana pranks, water gun chaos, balls, toys, and surprises
- Unlockable hats and player customization
- Food items that change character face textures
- Coins, achievements, and replayable challenges
- Short sessions made for quick VR fun

Kids Chaos VR is a family-friendly comedy-style VR game designed for teens and adults who enjoy lighthearted chaos, silly interactions, and playful sandbox moments.
